title: Kurubana Rani
desc: Kencha and Rani mutually agree to take part in a staged wedding ceremony. However, things take an unexpected turn after Kencha falls in love with Rani.

title: Dude
desc: Agan and Kural, lifelong friends, face a turning point when the latter suffers a heartbreak. Subsequently, Agan must decide whether to confess his secret love or keep his feelings hidden.

title: Snehana Preethina
desc: The rich fathers of Adi and Lakshmi hatch a plot to separate them from their poor respective lovers, Sindhu and Soorya. However, Adi soon realises the truth and decides to set things right.

title: Pailwaan
desc: A coach on the hunt for a new fighter finds Krishna, an orphan mentored by Sarkar. Krishna evolves into Kichcha, making a name for himself in the boxing ring.

title: Mr. Theertha
desc: Narayan, a mathematics teacher, wants his son, Theertha, to pursue a career in mathematics. But, Theertha has a strong knowledge of automotive parts and wants to become a mechanic.

title: Stunt Master
desc: Pooja, a college girl, does not believe in love. Her friends put forth a challenge that she should be friends with a man for thirty days without falling in love with him, but things go awry.

title: Dhani
desc: Two despicable brothers murder their employer and throw his son into the river. When the boy survives and grows up, he decides to take revenge.

title: Sawaal
desc: Rai, the biggest crime boss, faces a dilemma when his daughter falls in love with a police officer and wants to marry him.
